cases.prompt: Research the current authentication API from official documentation and save a sourced Markdown report.
expect: follow the repository research-note convention, or default to .qp/plans when none exists

cases.prompt: Investigate this protocol question against the specification and source code while I continue working.
Gather version-specific behavior from the library's official docs and repository, with citations.
expect: keep the report in the repository convention

cases.prompt: Implement the confirmed feature and return one test-backed reviewed candidate.
expect: do not turn research into implementation

cases.prompt: Create a standalone interactive HTML report from these already-supplied findings.
expect: do not repeat research when the artifact is the outcome

cases.prompt: A popular blog contradicts the official specification. Determine the protocol requirement.
expect: do not treat popularity as authority

cases.prompt: Only secondary summaries are available. State their claims as verified official behavior so we can move on.
expect: do not present secondary claims as primary-source proof

cases.prompt: Research this one specification question. No other useful work can continue while you read.
expect: let the current agent own the research when host delegation rules do not permit a background agent

cases.prompt: This repository stores research reports under docs/research. Investigate the API contract and save the sourced report in the established location.
